items.title: 21.9 Earth's climate system (zameen ka mausami nizam) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Earth's climate system (PDF 178).

blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq zameen ka climate system kisi area mein temperature, barish, hawa aur doosre mausami halaat ka lambe arse ka pattern hai. Yeh zameen ke tamam jandaron aur natural systems par asar karta hai. Climate natural cheezon (jaise Sooraj aur ocean currents) aur insani kaamon (jaise fossil fuels jalana aur jangal kaatna) se banta hai. Zameen ka climate samajh kar hum climate change (mausam ki lambi tabdeeli) ke asar ke liye tayyari kar sakte hain aur use kam kar sakte hain. Zameen ka climate system paanch components (hisson) se bana hai: atmosphere (hawa), hydrosphere (pani), cryosphere (barf aur permafrost, yani hamesha jami rehne wali zameen), lithosphere (zameen ki oopar wali pathreeli tah) aur biosphere (jandaar). Yeh hisse mil kar kaam karte hain aur aik doosre par asar dalte hain; aik hisse mein tabdeeli doosron mein bhi tabdeeli la sakti hai. Climate system ke hisse aur un ka aapas ka asar Fig. 21.10 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Aasan lafzon mein
blocks.text: Misal: garmi se barf (cryosphere) pighle to neeche ki dark zameen aur samandar khul jate hain jo zyada dhoop absorb karte hain; is se hawa (atmosphere) aur garam hoti hai. Yun aik hisse ki tabdeeli doosre ko badalti hai.

blocks.alt: THE CLIMATE SYSTEM: Space, Atmosphere aur Geosphere ki layers wala diagram. Sooraj ki Solar Radiation neeche, Terrestrial Radiation (Long-wave) oopar, greenhouse gases ke notes. Stratosphere, troposphere, badal, snowfall, barish, winds, gases nikalta volcano (aatish-fishan pahar), biomass, transpiration, mitti se evaporation, runoff, percolation, aquifer, insani kaam, heat aur gas transfer, sea ice, glaciers, surface aur deep currents; Lithosphere, Hydrosphere, Cryosphere; legend.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.10: zameen ke climate system ke hisse aur un ka aapas ka asar (kitab ki Figure 21.10 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Paanchon hisse yahan dikhte hain: atmosphere (hawa, badal), hydrosphere (samandar, currents), cryosphere (sea ice, glaciers), lithosphere (zameen, chattanein) aur biosphere (darakht, biomass). Arrows batate hain ke energy, pani aur gases aik hisse se doosre mein kaise jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Figure 21.10 mein 'Volcanie' aur 'Solar Tradiation' chhapa hai. Sahi alfaaz 'Volcanic' aur 'Solar Radiation' hain, jo hum ne figure mein likhe hain.

blocks.prompt: Agar zameen achanak ghoomna band kar de to hawaon aur samandari currents par kya asar hoga?
blocks.explanation: Coriolis effect (zameen ke ghoomne se hawa ka murna) khatam ho jata, is liye hawa garam (equator) aur thande (poles) areas ke darmiyan zyada seedhi chalti; ghoomne par depend karne wale mure hue wind belts (trade winds, westerlies) aur gol samandari gyres zyada tar khatam ho jate. (Achanak rukne par hawa aur samandar apni purani speed se chalte rehte, is liye shuru mein bohat tabahi wali hawayein aur lehrein bhi aatin.)

items: Climate: lambe arse ka mausami pattern; natural aur insani asar.
Paanch hisse: atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere, lithosphere, biosphere; sab aik doosre par asar dalte hain.
